decisions: AzureBlobStore implements the existing ObjectStore replacement contract with upload_blob(overwrite=True), validates relative POSIX object paths, and exposes no read operation.
AzureQueueSender accepts structured messages, serializes deterministic JSON, and only exposes send through its queue boundary.

AzureBlobSasIssuer obtains a user delegation key through a caller-supplied token credential, issues read-only permissions for one validated blob path, and enforces the T026 maximum TTL of 86400 seconds with the configured default of 900 seconds.
AzureJobStorage delegates get, upsert, and list operations to the T024 JobRepository implementation, preserving the existing testable Table adapter contract.
Endpoint factories pass the caller-supplied TokenCredential directly to Azure SDK clients; no credential discovery or secret-bearing storage configuration is introduced.
limitations: All focused tests use local SDK-shaped fakes and a patched SAS signer; no live Azure request was made.

A deployed runtime still requires an Azure identity with Storage Blob Data Contributor, Storage Queue Data Contributor, and Storage Table Data Contributor access as applicable; user-delegation SAS issuance additionally requires Microsoft.Storage/storageAccounts/blobServices/generateUserDelegationKey/action, commonly granted by Storage Blob Delegator.
